name: Alpengasthof Gruberhof
beschreibung: The Alpengasthof Gruberhof is situated on a plateau above **Söll**. The rooms feature balconies with views of the Kaisergebirge mountains. The restaurant offers dishes made with locally sourced ingredients. In winter, a shuttle bus takes guests to the lifts of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser. In summer, the farm serves as a direct starting point for hiking and mountain biking tours. A wellness area with a sauna and a sunbathing area round out the amenities. The business is run by a family.
